source: Extracted from index.html, the 13 project HTML files, and i18n.js (en section) in the primary repo. This file is a reference data layer only; the live website does NOT consume it. See docs/JSON_FIRST_MIGRATION_PLAN.md.

field_legend.id: Stable identifier matching the i18n key prefix used in i18n.js (NOT always equal to the page filename — see notes for each project).
field_legend.title: Display title as shown on the homepage card.
field_legend.slug: URL-safe kebab-case identifier; matches the page filename without the .html extension.
field_legend.page: Detail-page HTML filename at the repo root.
field_legend.category: data-category attribute on the homepage card. One of: master, bachelor, internship.
field_legend.type: data-type attribute on the homepage card. One of: architecture, furniture, 3dprinting, vr, other.
field_legend.year: Year extracted from the card subtitle string.
field_legend.location: Location extracted from the card subtitle string.
field_legend.role: Designer's role on the project. Mostly null because there is no single canonical source in the current HTML; see notes per project where a role key (v.role.*) is present in the detail page.
field_legend.coverImage: Icon image used by the homepage card. Path is relative to repo root, preserved exactly as it appears in index.html.
field_legend.images: All files in the project's image folder. Paths preserved as they appear in the file system. Includes images used by the page plus any unused / archived images. Filtering to only used images would require parsing each detail HTML; not done in this pass.
field_legend.displayedTagsRaw: The exact contents of the <div class="tags"> element on the homepage card.
field_legend.dataTags: The data-tags attribute on the homepage card, split on whitespace.
field_legend.shortDescription: Sidebar description paragraph 1, extracted from i18n.js EN section ({prefix}.desc.p1).
field_legend.longDescription: Sidebar description paragraph 2, extracted from i18n.js EN section ({prefix}.desc.p2).
field_legend.i18nPrefix: The string used as the namespace prefix for all of this project's i18n keys.
field_legend.i18nKeys: All unique data-i18n keys referenced by the project's detail page HTML (sorted alphabetically). Includes shared keys (intro.label, meta.*, ui.*, v.*) as well as project-specific keys.
field_legend.isFeatured: Feature-flag candidate for future use. No signal in current HTML — always null.
field_legend.sourceFiles: Filesystem references that define this project.
field_legend.notes: Free-form notes covering uncertainties, special cases, and discrepancies between the HTML, the i18n keys, and the folder layout.

projects.title: Commune
projects.shortDescription: A timber extension to an existing residential building at Katajaharjuntie 22, Helsinki.
projects.longDescription: The project asks how a new wooden volume can densify an existing block without losing its social character. The extension adds housing below and a shared communal floor above — combining private and collective living within a single prefabricated structure.
projects.notes: Both ascii-quoted (correct) and curly-quoted (broken) data-i18n attributes existed in this file prior to 2026-05-18; the curly-quote bug at lines 62/65 was fixed in commit d89a63d (primary) / 214c803 (backup). Folder includes both hero.jpg and hero.png — confirm which is referenced by the page if pruning is desired. Role not declared; project description implies architectural design but no v.role.* key is used.

projects.title: Stool
projects.shortDescription: A solid birch stool developed through the furniture studio course at Aalto University.
projects.longDescription: Shaped by structural logic and material restraint. Construction simplicity and careful proportion are treated as the primary design tools — the result is a stable, lightweight object with no applied decoration.
projects.notes: Material key v.mat.birch is used on this page; one of only a few pages with a meta material declaration. PORTFOLIO_I18N_STATE.md reports 13 caption keys with 'some commented out' — i18n.js still holds the full set.

projects.title: Cultural Center
projects.shortDescription: A public building at the transition between Longtan historic town and the surrounding mountain, Nanjing.
projects.longDescription: Sited on a former quarry, the building is organised as a movement sequence — platforms and thresholds that guide visitors from town into the landscape. A reciprocal timber structure gives the building its spatial and structural character.
projects.notes: Page filename uses 'cultural-center' but i18n prefix is 'cultural'. Role inferred from v.role.arch-design key shown in PORTFOLIO_I18N_STATE.md to be used by this page. Displayed tag '#Wood Frame' contains a space — interpretation is ambiguous; preserved as a raw string.

projects.title: 3D-Printed Bamboo Components System
projects.shortDescription: A 3D-printed node system derived from the structural logic of traditional bamboo scaffolding.
projects.longDescription: The project translates friction-based bamboo connections into a digitally manufactured joint for large-scale temporary structures. A single parametric node type adapts across different configurations — pavilions, markets, exhibition structures — driven by the same geometric principle.
projects.notes: Curly-quote i18n bug fixed 2026-05-18 (see commit d89a63d/214c803). Folder includes many auto-generated names and 'Canvas at 14;45;40 1.png' with semicolons — preserved exactly. v.type.master used for project type.

projects.title: RUACH
projects.shortDescription: An interactive VR prototype developed at the Technical University of Munich.
projects.longDescription: RUACH functions as a subconscious spatial guide — users make a series of intuitive choices about environment, material, sound, and light, and the system assembles a personal virtual space in response. The architecture is not fixed; it is built through use.
projects.notes: Special case: the homepage card titled 'RUACH' links to tri-stool.html (legacy filename) and pulls its icon and assets from the ruach/ folder. The tri-stool/ folder is empty. There is a separate, currently-commented-out card on the homepage for a future genuine tri-stool entry. v.type.group used. Includes hero.mp4 and Media2.mp4 video assets.

projects.title: How to Print a House - Vault House
projects.shortDescription: A 3D-printed library extension at the Altes Hallenbad site in Heidelberg.
projects.longDescription: The project uses structural optimisation to generate a vaulted concrete slab, fabricated through robotic 3D printing. The form is shaped by load distribution — reducing material while improving the building's thermal and structural performance.
projects.notes: Page filename 'vault-house', i18n prefix 'vault'. Folder includes two PDF presentation deliverables. Displayed tag string has a trailing space — preserved exactly. No v.type.* key on this page despite having Type meta label in i18nKeys; verify by reading the sidebar block.

projects.title: The Tea Room
projects.shortDescription: A small hillside building along the path between Longtan village and the mountain, Nanjing.
projects.longDescription: Set into a forested slope, the building offers a quiet stop along the ascent — space for rest and informal gathering. The section compresses and opens in response to the site, framing the landscape while remaining embedded in it.
projects.notes: Display tags ('#Concrete #Public') and dataTags ('concrete landscape') disagree — both preserved for honesty. script.js swaps display order between tearoom and Single-family-home under the architecture filter.

projects.title: Single-family home
projects.shortDescription: A two-storey single-family house in Katajaharju, Helsinki.
projects.longDescription: A compact concrete structure for a low-density residential plot. The project uses section, material honesty, and structural discipline to produce a house that responds to climate and neighbourhood scale within a constrained footprint.
projects.notes: Capitalised filename and folder ('Single-family-home') — GitHub Pages is case-sensitive. Page i18n prefix is 'sfh' per PORTFOLIO_I18N_SYSTEM.md mapping. script.js swaps display order between this and tearoom under the architecture filter. No meta.type i18n key listed on this page — sidebar type may be hardcoded in HTML or omitted.

projects.title: Furniture in Park
projects.shortDescription: A set of outdoor seating elements for the lawn area of WestK Art Park, Hong Kong.
projects.longDescription: Designed for durable, low-maintenance outdoor use. The pieces respond to the material constraints and specific conditions of the park's landscape without competing with it.
projects.notes: Page filename 'furniture-park', i18n prefix 'park'. v.loc.westk = 'WestK Art Park, Hong Kong'. PORTFOLIO_I18N_STATE.md reports 'park.intro.b1..b3' (3 introduction bullets) — fewer than the typical 4 on other pages.

projects.title: Studio Renovation - Corridor bridge
projects.shortDescription: A lightweight steel bridge connecting two parts of an existing studio complex in Dali, Yunnan.
projects.longDescription: The bridge spans a water feature between two existing buildings, forming a clear spatial link while keeping the view to the landscape open. The structure is minimal — the corridor itself becomes the architectural event.
projects.notes: data-tags='steel ' has a trailing space in index.html (preserved as 'steel' single token after split). Role inferred from PORTFOLIO_I18N_STATE.md showing v.role.internship for this page. Uses meta.office (rare across pages).

projects.title: Nyamata Hospital
projects.shortDescription: An on-site design intervention at Nyamata District Hospital, Rwanda.
projects.longDescription: Rather than a full rebuild, the project works within the existing hospital to improve patient flow, waiting conditions, and accessibility. The interventions are precise and buildable — developed directly from observation of how the building is used each day.
projects.notes: v.type.design-camp used (humanitarian design camp context). v.loc.nyamata = 'Nyamata District Hospital, Rwanda'. Display tags '#Hospital #Design' don't appear in the dataTags ('landscape') — they are presentational only.

projects.title: Study-group Works
projects.shortDescription: A 1:50 physical model reconstruction of Ignazio Gardella's PAC — Padiglione d'Arte Contemporanea.
projects.longDescription: The model is built as a tool for understanding, not for presentation. Working at 1:50 forces a close reading of proportion, structure, and spatial sequence — making visible what drawings alone cannot show.
projects.notes: Filename/folder casing differs: page is 'Study-group-Works.html' but folder is 'study-group/'. i18n prefix is 'study'. Uses meta.partners and meta.project (rare keys). v.type.study-group used. data-tags='model ' has a trailing space (preserved as 'model' after split). No meta.location i18n key on this page.

projects.title: Spirulina Biolamp
projects.shortDescription: A living lamp integrating spirulina algae into a functional light object.
projects.longDescription: Transparent acrylic cylinders hold living algae, lit by integrated LEDs. The light is functional and biological simultaneously — it reveals the algae's colour gradients while sustaining photosynthesis. The lamp changes over time as the culture grows.
projects.notes: Role inferred from PORTFOLIO_I18N_STATE.md (v.role.design-dev associated with spirulina). Includes process-2.jpeg with .jpeg extension (other images are .jpg). No meta.location key on the page (Helsinki location is inferred from the card subtitle, not the sidebar meta block).

hidden_or_commented_out.note: An additional card for 'Tri-Stool' (#Furniture #Wood, Helsinki / Master 2025) exists in index.html but is wrapped in HTML comments. Its icon path would be tri-stool/tri_stool_icon.jpg in the tri-stool/ folder (currently empty). Keeping this entry hidden until the genuine tri-stool entry is published. The visible 'RUACH' entry above uses the tri-stool.html page filename for legacy reasons.
